tsh.options.title: TeamSpeak HUD
tsh.options.description: Connects to your local TeamSpeak client via the ClientQuery plugin and shows who is in your channel and who is talking while you play.
tsh.options.enabled.description: Turns TeamSpeak HUD on or off. Disabling it closes the TeamSpeak connection and hides the HUD from your screen.
tsh.options.max_displayed_members.descri: Limits how many members are listed at once, so a busy channel does not cover half your screen. Anyone beyond this limit is collapsed into a single "+N more" line.
tsh.options.manual_api_key.description: Overrides the API key used to connect to TeamSpeak's ClientQuery plugin. Leave this empty to detect it automatically from clientquery.ini.
